entities.name: snow-covered competition ski course
entities.identification: A broad, relatively flat white ski course extending into the distance within the protective boundaries along the blue markings.

entities.name: blue route markings on the snow surface
entities.identification: Blue long lines, curved bands of color, and local transverse short strokes on the snow surface.

entities.name: protective facilities along the edge of the course
entities.identification: Red advertising barriers, red net fencing, and local light-colored barriers along the edge of the course.

entities.name: snow-covered coniferous forest
entities.identification: A group of dark-colored coniferous trees outside the ski course, with crowns at varying heights that are nearly conical and covered with snow.

entities.name: blue-covered course equipment
entities.identification: A locally exposed cyan-blue covered section behind the distant light-colored barrier and in front of the trees, adjacent to an inclined component.

entities.name: Object O
entities.identification: An orange-red two-pole gate beside the blue curved line, with a black panel bearing the white word BOSS in the center of the orange-red banner.

entities.name: tips of the red skis
entities.identification: Two red ski tips with rounded ends that appear intermittently along the bottom edge of the image.

entities.name: black-and-white ski glove
entities.identification: A thick glove briefly visible along the bottom edge, with light-colored panels, black edging, and dark-colored joined sections.

entities.name: gray-blue sky
entities.identification: A low-contrast gray-blue sky with gentle brightness variations above the treetops and distant mountains.

entities.name: snow-covered hillside outside the course
entities.identification: A dim gray slope and light whitish snow-covered areas locally exposed outside the protective boundary and behind the distant tree line.

entities.name: first-person-view red ski pole
entities.identification: A slender red pole segment that briefly appears in the bottom-right corner near the end of the clip.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: A person in winter clothing wearing a red top and dark-colored pants at the right edge in frame 41, beside the end of the red barrier.
